title: CJP Ultimatum to CEC Gyanesh Kumar Expires; Nationwide Agitation to Begin in Mumbai Oct 2
detail: The Saturday Sep 26 deadline set by Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign passed with no resignation reported. CJP announced its nationwide agitation will begin in Mumbai on Oct 2 (Gandhi Jayanti) and extend to cities across India. Mumbai's Azad Maidan is the likely venue, but police permission had not yet been secured.

media.caption: CJP demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation; agitation planned from Oct 2.
